messages:
maria: Heads-up — after today's RBAC refactor rollout (workspace-affinity enforcement) we've had at least 3 reports of cross-workspace read access to model artifacts. Putting repro + logs below.

kevin: ack. Can you paste a minimal repro and which deploy/flag changed?

maria: repro: use a service token without X-Workspace header but with project_alias claim. Request succeeds and returns artifact from a different workspace. Sample log later. The change was the rollout of `rbac-variant-v2` + enabling `workspace_affinity=true` in the feature flag.

sec-bot: Alert created IN-2026-023 - potential cross-workspace data access (severity=high) :eyes:

samir: oh — is this the resolver change where project aliases are looked up in a merged index? I thought lookups were scoped to workspace_id first.

maria: exactly. Bug is in `namespace-resolver` (pkg/names/resolve.go). If header `X-Workspace` is missing, code falls back to an org-wide alias match and returns the first match, not an error. So service accounts with only org-scoped project_alias can resolve to other workspaces.

ashley: also noticing audit logs are missing around the window. Our new log shipper had a config change in the same deploy that excluded `role.assign` events. I don't see `auth.grant` entries at 11:01.

kevin: mitigation proposals: 1) hotfix namespace-resolver to require explicit workspace header or token workspace claim; 2) rollback feature flag while we patch; 3) ingress-proxy deny for requests missing X-Workspace (except whitelisted runners); 4) review KMS key policies and consider rotation if decrypts happened cross-workspace.

ops-oncall: temporary network block of the affected artifact buckets will immediately stop further exfil. I can do that now.

samir: repro steps I ran: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer svc-token" https://artifacts.redwood/model/xyz` (no X-Workspace) -> 200 and model binary returned. Logs: `KMS.decrypt key=arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111:key/AAA principal=svc-deploy result=SUCCESS`. KMS key policy includes org-level principal `org:svc-*`.

maria: that matches: KMS scoping cleanup last month used org-level principals for backward compatibility. Combined with resolver bug it's a bad combo.

ashley: audit shipper config had `rbac-evts.exclude=["role.assign"]` in prod — looks accidental. We should revert that so we have a record of grants.

kevin: action plan agreed: rollback now, patch resolver, revert shipper config, add proxy check, and then review KMS policies. Which is highest priority?

maria: rollback + proxy check are highest. Then KMS policy least-privilege plan. Also detection rule for mismatched workspaces.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback started for featureflag workspace_affinity in prod.

kevin: I'll push a small ingress middleware to reject requests missing X-Workspace header unless token has `service_runner:true` claim. Will canary it.

ops-oncall: canary shows intermittent 503s for internal jobs — need to whitelist some runners. Which tokens legitimately omit header?

maria: internal job runners have claim `service_runner:true`. We should whitelist by claim but gate it to a small allowlist while we migrate.

samir: alternative: prefer rollback of the feature flag while we fix resolver + KMS, less blast radius.

deploy-bot: Rollback completed at 2475309800: workspace_affinity=false in prod.

sec-bot: Incident IN-2026-023 updated: state=mitigated, notes="flag rollback performed; ingress ACLs applied; audit shipper revert pending".

maria: sample logs attached below for triage:
```
[2026-03-20T11:01:22Z] request_id=abc123 user=svc-deploy token=tok-xyz target=artifact://s3/model/face-detect workspace_header="" resolved_workspace=workspace-omega decision=ALLOW policy=rbac-variant-v2
[2026-03-20T11:01:23Z] kms=decrypt key=arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111:key/AAA principal=svc-deploy result=SUCCESS
```

ashley: I found shipper PR that introduced the exclude; reverting now. PR# 4592.

ops-oncall: I applied temporary bucket ACLs blocking non-owner workspace principals. That stopped 9 artifact accesses between 2026-03-20T11:00 and 11:15.

samir: quick audit: ~120 service accounts still rely on org-level project aliases. We'll need a migration plan to attach explicit workspace claims or require X-Workspace header. Scheduling a migration doc.

kevin: I'll open the hotfix PR for namespace-resolver and the ingress middleware. Will tag for fast-track review. PRs: resolver#4720, ingress#4721.

maria: next steps (owners): 1) kevin — push hotfix + ingress canary, 2) ashley — revert shipper and verify audit events, 3) ops-oncall — keep ACLs and provide list of affected artifacts, 4) samir — migration plan for org-scoped accounts, 5) legal & support notified for customer impact.

ashley: pinging legal & support now.

kevin: thanks. After hotfix and shipper revert let's run a detection query: `select * from auth_logs where resolved_workspace != token_workspace` and alert on >0.

maria: I'll draft the post-incident timeline once we confirm no further cross-workspace decrypts. Add me to followups. :thumbsup:

ops-oncall: closing temporary ACLs only after we have resolver + ingress in prod and shipper reverted.

maria: thanks everyone — good triage. We'll convert this to a full incident report and postmortem.
